text:
noah: Morning pulse — quick check for AMS/IE GPU headroom. We're seeing a small spike on embeddings; can folks post region headroom and any quota blockers? Planning to enable +10% burst from reserved pool if safe.

aya: Ran the preflight this AM. Drained 2 test nodes in AMS for kernel patch, they're back online. Current headroom: eu-west1 (AMS): ~18% free (~12 GPUs), us-central (IE): ~9% free (~6 GPUs). No pending quota tickets on my side.

omar: Filed a quota increase with cloud for us-central — requesting +12 A100s, ticket INC-4521. ETA 48-72h. Noted the spike; may need temporary burst. @noah FYI.

liam: Observed embeddings batch len spike (2x) from 03:00-04:30 UTC — looks like a noisy warmup job from `client:batch-worker-9`. Throttled that client to 20rps for now. Will watch if latency stabilizes.

rachel: If we open burst, can we route a small % to the cheaper M60 fallback pool as a graceful degradation? I can push a canary routing change (A/B 5%). Also we should update the SLO runbook for burst-triggered rollbacks.

infra-bot: [capacity-alert] eu-west1 burst pool usage 82% — recommendation: consider enabling reserved-burst-2. Quick check: `redwoodctl capacity describe --region eu-west1`

aya: Quick run: `redwoodctl capacity describe --region eu-west1 --json` shows reserved-burst-2 available with 8 GPUs free and no overlapping canaries. Can enable short burst safely.

noah: Plan: enable +10% reserved-burst for 2h at :05 past the hour, monitor latency and error rates. @omar hold on quota escalation for permanent scale until we see post-burst metrics. @rachel canary routing change approved at :10 past the hour. I'll flip burst at :05, will post stats in 15m. :thumbsup:

liam: 👍 will watch token latency and queue depth, will alert if p95 rises > 25%

omar: Acknowledge — standing down on immediate scale, will follow up with cloud ticket updates.

rachel: Thanks — I'll draft the quick SLO note and add rollback steps.

noah: Thanks team — report back in this thread after 15m check.
_notes: Single-thread Slack conversation. Short, operational updates and quick coordination for GPU capacity and burst activation.
